griidc-adt-2025.citation: DUACS (2025), Gridded absolute dynamic topography – Gulf subset – daily time series 1993–2019, GRIIDC.
griidc-adt-2025.access: Original 757,416,604-byte NetCDF independently SHA-verified and processed in the cloud on one low-priority CPU. Daily slice only; original raw fields are not retained locally. Product 202411 uses CNES-CLS2022 MDT per producer documentation. Source-case comparison uses original Hamilton et al. 2019 Figure 2 / section 3, actual PDF pages 5–6 and cloud comparison image visually reviewed. These quantities are OSW-derived, not author-reported dimensions.

hamilton-2019.citation: Hamilton, Bower, Furey, Leben and Perez-Brunius (2019), The Loop Current: Observations of Deep Eddies and Topographic Waves, JPO 49, 1463–1483.
hamilton-2019.access: Original author-institution PDF acquired; actual pages 5–6 reviewed. Map used for named-case/date/spatial comparison, not as the gridded numeric input.

records.source_locator: Original NetCDF time index 7394, 2013-03-31 daily ADT field; named-case comparison: Hamilton 2019 Figure 2, printed 1467/PDF page 5, 31 March panel; chronology: section 3, printed 1468/PDF page 6.
records.period_label: 2013-03-31 daily gridded ADT snapshot; not the final-separation date
records.definition: Spherical area enclosed by the selected daily demeaned-ADT contour.
records.scope: OSW-derived daily gridded reference associated with the source-labeled first Kraken detachment. Registry physical crosswalk unverified; registry initial separation remains 2013-04-08. No measurements inherited to or from other Kraken records.
records.qualification: Six method scenarios: 0.15/0.17/0.19 m contours after Gulf daily demeaning using arithmetic and cosine-latitude means. All nine primary-map interior probes uniquely select one candidate per scenario. Outward rounding is a reporting choice. Mapping/MDT errors, effective resolution and physical-front error are unquantified. This is method sensitivity, not measurement uncertainty, an annual range or a physical boundary. First March detachment precedes later reattachments and August departure; no lifetime inferred.
